fields.label: Default Contract Validity Days
fields.description: Default number of days a new sales contract remains valid when no end date is provided.

fields.label: Contract Number Prefix
fields.description: Prefix used when generating sales contract numbers. Example: SC will produce SC-2026-00001.

fields.label: Default Down Payment Percent
fields.description: Default down payment percentage applied when generating installment schedules.

fields.label: Allow Duplicate Contract For Same Unit
fields.description: When disabled, a unit with an active sales contract cannot be contracted again. When enabled, additional contracts are allowed for the same unit.

fields.label: Require Customer
fields.description: Require an existing Customer before a sales contract can be submitted. Disabling allows Individual buyers without a Customer record.

fields.label: Require Installment Schedule
fields.description: Require at least one installment row and total installment amount must match net contract price within the tolerance percentage.

fields.label: Installment Amount Tolerance Percent
fields.description: Maximum allowed percentage difference between total installment amounts and net contract price. Default is 0.5 percent.

fields.label: Mark Unit Sold On Approval
fields.description: When enabled, submitting an approved sales contract changes the unit status to Sold.

fields.label: Enable Sales Invoice Generation
fields.description: Keep disabled in this phase. Sales Invoice generation from installment schedule will be implemented in a later phase.

fields.label: Default Currency From Company
fields.description: When enabled, currency defaults from the company currency rather than a country-specific currency.

name: Sales Contract Settings
description: Controls sales contract behavior, numbering, validation, and installment defaults for real estate unit sales.
